test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 04
subject: general
question:
In this question, three statements are given followed by three conclusions. Choose the conclusion(s) which best fit(s) logically.

Statements:

1) Some actors are writers.

2) All writers are dancers.

3) No actor is a director.

Conclusions:

I. No writer is an actor.

II. Some actors are dancers.

III. Some writers are not directors.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions II and III follow

solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/348f982b0f11da79622a28648c7ff0060dd4610e466d7b8200b60c592ba2a0d8.png] 

Concept:

1) We have to check the conclusions are 100% match with the statement. If the conclusion is 100% match with the given statement then the conclusion is true. If there is a 1% chance of not following the statement then the conclusion is considered to be false.

2) The possibility case can be considered to be "false" in "definite case".

3) In Possibility case, either "can" or "possible" word must be present.

The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a9ac8d9476b6b5b73cb7040649902d0628f3d997fb625684d6726677c8d81d4.png] 

I. No writer is an actor. → False (As, Some actors are writers → so the conclusion cannot be true)

II. Some actors are dancers. → True (As, Some actors are writers and All writers are dancers → so some actors are dancers)

III. Some writers are not directors. → True (As, Some actors are writers, All writers are dancers, and No actor is a director → so some writers who are actors are not directors)

Hence, only conclusions II and III follow.
